"""history_build.py - builds the history tables for Let Him Cook from nflverse.

Writes four CSVs next to itself (or to --out):
  injury_history.csv  durability from games actually missed to injury, body-part history,
                      recurring injuries, illness weeks
  teammates.csv       how teammates' weekly scores move together (shrunk for sample size)
  qb_effect.csv       each receiver's scoring with his usual QB vs a backup, same team and
                      same season only (so a team change is never mistaken for a QB change)
  handcuffs.csv       what each backup scored in games his starter missed, vs games they shared
  pos_risk.csv        weekly odds of missing a game hurt, and of a season fading, by position,
                      age band and workload band (injury_history.csv carries each man's own)

Run weekly (Tuesday, after Monday night). Needs only the standard library and network access
to github.com. Every number here was checked by hand against known cases before it was
trusted: backups are not "fragile" just for not playing, a player who moved teams is not
"helped by a new QB", and two backs who never shared the field are not a handcuff pair.
"""
import argparse, collections, csv, io, math, os, statistics, sys, urllib.request

BASE = "https://github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data/releases/download"
SKILL = ("QB", "RB", "WR", "TE")
INJ_RES = {"R01", "R48", "R04", "R05"}          # injured reserve, IR-return, PUP, non-football injury
SOFT = {"hamstring", "groin", "calf", "quad", "thigh", "oblique"}
PARTS = ("hamstring", "ankle", "knee", "concussion", "groin", "calf", "foot", "shoulder", "back", "hip",
         "quad", "illness", "achilles", "toe", "ribs", "neck", "hand", "wrist", "thumb", "finger", "elbow",
         "oblique", "pectoral", "chest", "heel", "thigh", "abdomen", "forearm")


def fetch(url, cache):
    if cache and os.path.exists(cache):
        with open(cache, encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as h:
            return list(csv.DictReader(h))
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=180) as r:
        txt = r.read().decode("utf-8-sig")
    if cache:
        with open(cache, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as h:
            h.write(txt)
    return list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(txt)))


def num(x):
    try:
        return float(x or 0)
    except ValueError:
